# The Steak House on The Verandah
> Historic Devon House, 26 Hope Road, Kingston 10, Jamaica | (876) 616-8831 | reservations@steakhouseja.com

## Overview
The Steak House on The Verandah is Kingston, Jamaica's premier fine-dining chophouse, situated directly on the iconic colonial verandah of George Stiebel's 1881 Devon House estate. It combines Himalayan salt dry-aged USDA Prime and Wagyu steaks with Caribbean ocean specialties, authentic Jamaican culinary infusions, and an extensive vintage wine and rum cellar.

## Key Information
- Location: Devon House, 26 Hope Road, Suite 1, Kingston 10, Jamaica
- Coordinates: 18.0148763, -76.7898652
- Phone: +1 876-616-8831 / +1 876-403-6249
- Cuisine: Fine Dining Chophouse, Himalayan Dry-Aged Steaks, Caribbean Fusion, Seafood
- Operating Hours:
  - Tuesday – Saturday: 11:30 AM – 10:00 PM
  - Sunday: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM
  - Monday: Closed
- Reservations: Recommended via online concierge or direct telephone.

## Signature Offerings
- 38oz Prime Dry-Aged Tomahawk Ribeye (45-day Himalayan salt aged)
- Blue Mountain Coffee-Crusted Filet Mignon
- Charred Caribbean Rock Lobster Tail with escovitch butter
- Handcrafted Truffle Fettuccine with aged parmesan crisp
- Devon House Heritage Rum flights and Old World Bordeaux reserve cellar
